releases.release_notes: Forgot your password by email, hang up a call from Active Calls, closed days and moving holidays in time conditions, buildings and departments, and a fix: extensions can now be placed at a site so emergency routing and readiness count them.

releases.release_notes: Milestone 21, provisioning breadth: provisioning variables (one value per building, profile or organization), more key types (voicemail, intercom, DND, park, toggles), Yealink (every current SIP model), Algo (every current SIP endpoint), Poly Edge E and CCX, phone directory, redirect services. New templates are experimental until checked on hardware.
releases.service_impact: The web interface and API restart (under a minute); calls are not interrupted. The telephony configuration changes when you next deploy (parking lamps, DND and queue lamp codes).

releases.release_notes: Phones online graph on the overview (registered against known phones). Security hardening from the CodeQL review: TLS 1.2 minimum on the certificate probe, backup job name validation, recording path containment, CSP hash regex. Test fixes.

releases.release_notes: My Phone widgets fit their size instead of being cropped: the title stays put and the content scrolls; lists show as many rows as fit with Show all; the fax form folds in a short widget.

releases.release_notes: Fax: send a PDF from My Phone (cover sheet, state, retry, cancel, PDF); fax inboxes 'Fax to email' as a destination; T.38 per trunk; who may fax per class of service; Fax page for administrators. The upgrade installs ghostscript and libtiff-tools.

releases.release_notes: Updates: Install now keeps the review window open on the live progress and ends with a Reload the page button.

releases.release_notes: Agent log-in and pause from the queue page or the API now write the marks the phone's *45/*46 toggles read. Updates: releases older than the installed one are no longer offered (superseded) and the list is newest first.
releases.service_impact: The web interface and API restart (under a minute); calls are not interrupted.

releases.release_notes: Milestone 20, the user portal: voicemail inbox and greetings on My Phone (new helper service veyra-vmstore), personal contacts and speed dials, recent calls with own recordings behind an organization setting, presence with automatic actions and a colleagues view, user-set phone keys in slots administrators leave open (all other keys locked), and My Phone as a canvas of widgets with administrator layout templates. Migrations 0047-0051. Fax follows as 0.26.x. Notes: https://github.com/manderson20/veyra/releases/tag/v0.26.0
releases.service_impact: The web interface and API restart (under a minute); calls are not interrupted. A new service, veyra-vmstore, is installed and started.

releases.release_notes: Fixes from the Milestone 19 live check: the in-call codes (*1 record, *2 attended transfer, ## blind transfer) never reached the phone system because the engine's features reload used a console command Asterisk 22 no longer has; and queue agent state set from the page now writes the marks the phone's *45/*46 toggles read. Deploy the configuration once after installing to activate the in-call codes. Notes: https://github.com/manderson20/veyra/releases/tag/v0.25.5
releases.service_impact: The web interface and API restart (under a minute); calls are not interrupted.

releases.release_notes: Install now starts the upgrade service at once instead of waiting up to a minute for the background worker's pass; the same checks run and the same root unit does the work. Notes: https://github.com/manderson20/veyra/releases/tag/v0.25.4
releases.service_impact: The web interface and API restart (under a minute); calls are not interrupted.

releases.release_notes: The installation card on System → Updates shows every stage from the approval on: approved, picked up by the background worker (with the time to its next pass), release verified and unpacked, installer running (current step), finished — with the time since the approval. The process itself is unchanged; stages that used to pass silently are now visible. Notes: https://github.com/manderson20/veyra/releases/tag/v0.25.3
releases.service_impact: The web interface and API restart (under a minute); calls are not interrupted.

releases.release_notes: The Updates page now follows an installation live from the moment it is approved (waiting notice until the installer starts, step, elapsed time, installer output scrolled to the newest line). Includes the 0.25.1 fix for the upgrade stopping at 'Configuring NGINX'. Notes: https://github.com/manderson20/veyra/releases/tag/v0.25.2
releases.service_impact: The web interface and API restart (under a minute); calls are not interrupted.

releases.release_notes: Fixes the 0.25.0 upgrade stopping at 'Configuring NGINX' (the Content-Security-Policy header with 81 script hashes passed NGINX's 4096-byte parameter limit; the installer now hands the hashes over in chunks). Servers that hit the failure are on 0.25.0 with NGINX still serving the previous header; installing this release completes the upgrade. Notes: https://github.com/manderson20/veyra/releases/tag/v0.25.1

releases.release_notes: Milestone 19, call-flow features: announcements, dial-by-name directory, conference rooms, call flows (day/night switches), time-condition override, call parking, blocked callers, queue dynamic agents and break-out menu, in-call recording and transfer codes. Migrations 0042-0046; new managed Asterisk files confbridge.conf, res_parking.conf and features.conf. Full notes: https://github.com/manderson20/veyra/releases/tag/v0.25.0
